pages.title: Manage Players
pages.text: In Settings, use Manage beside Trusted players. Add an online player name or a complete UUID for an offline player. The list supports up to 64 players. Remove revokes their access through Trusted mode.

pages.title: Change Owner
pages.text: Use the menu beside Owner to transfer ownership. Enter an online name or UUID. Transferring clears the old trusted list and may remove your management access. Operators keep administrative access.

pages.title: Unclaimed Displays
pages.text: An operator can claim an unowned legacy display before it can be edited. New displays placed by a player belong to that player. Automated placement leaves displays unclaimed.
